title: Opina
subtitle: Create surveys in minutes, let people vote and watch the results move live.

caseStudy.intro: Opina is a mobile-first survey app. Publish a survey with your own questions, share it and let people vote. Every result bar updates in real time for all visitors, without a reload.

title: Kanvera
subtitle: Plan, organize and execute work in one place: Board, Inbox, Team and Pulse.

caseStudy.intro: Kanvera is a project management app built without a framework. Tasks move across a Kanban board, personal work lands in the Inbox, the team is managed in one directory and Pulse shows how the day is going.

title: Chunky Pairs
subtitle: Flip cards, find matching pairs and race the clock in a head-to-head memory game.

caseStudy.intro: Chunky Pairs is a mobile-first memory card game with a bold Neo-Brutalist look. Choose a board, pick a visual theme and starting player, then compete in local multiplayer.

title: Neon City 2065
subtitle: Run, jump and fight through a side-scrolling action game in the browser.

caseStudy.intro: Neon City 2065 is a side-scrolling action game that runs in the browser. Fight your way through a dystopian neon metropolis, defeat enemies and survive dynamic combat scenarios in a fully custom-built game engine.
